falseSynonyms.zh: 百分點不等於 percent 由 20% 升至 25% 是增加 5 percentage points，不是增加 5%。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Percentage points measure the absolute difference between percentages.

falseSynonyms.zh: 分數不等於 percent fraction 可以用 1/2、3/4 等表示，不一定以每百為基準。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A fraction need not be out of 100.

falseSynonyms.zh: 比率不等於 percent ratio 比較兩個量，可寫成 2:3，不一定是百分比。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A ratio need not be a percentage.

falseSynonyms.zh: 比例不一定是 percent proportion 可以用小數、分數或百分數表示。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A proportion can be expressed in several forms.

falseSynonyms.zh: 率不等於 percent rate 是指標本身；百分數只是常見表達方式。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A rate may be expressed as a percentage.

falseSynonyms.zh: 機率不等於 percent 概率可以用百分數表示，但概念本身不同。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Probability is a concept that can be expressed as a percentage.

falseSynonyms.zh: 基點不等於 percent 1 basis point = 0.01 percentage point；常見於利率／金融。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Basis points are hundredths of a percentage point.

falseSynonyms.zh: 詞性與結構陷阱 percent/per cent 常直接跟數字；percentage 是名詞。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Percent and percentage have different grammatical patterns.
